goal: Fix Tarot deck first fold, preserve selected deck through explicit optional intention, explain actual selected reading and label save honestly without changing provider/billing/storage contracts.
successCriteria: All seven deck intros show title, brief value and localized tier before full contained artwork; no intrinsic source-height layout.
Deck-origin reading enters editable optional intention then spread without another required deck selection; quick entry no longer skips intention.
Why shows actual question, selected cards/positions/orientations and canonical reflective meanings; Save says save rather than write.
Existing ritual reset, premium/credit guards, artwork and Journal snapshots remain intact.
untouchedSurfaces: Canonical seed cards/decks are owned by the separate R20 executor; no edits to content JSON, Admin or provider prompts here.
Auth, Journal durable storage, entitlements, backend schemas, production and artwork exports remain unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Explore and Tarot deck intro, quick Tarot shortcut, topic/spread/draw/result and Why expansion; retain tab and back history.
impact.dataWrite: Only transient deck-origin selection and explanation state; existing onSave/sourceSnapshot contract preserved without new persistence.
impact.backendContract: No API schema, provider call or quota rule changed; selected-card interpretation stays in the existing reading contract.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin fields changed; current preview/live boundaries unaffected.
impact.privacySafety: Explain only actual app-selected cards and user question, do not invent why a provider chose a phrase; no new personal data, keys or telemetry.
impact.observability: Existing tarot_opened/quick_opened traces stay; explain label states symbolic seed explanation rather than a model chain of thought.
impact.rollback: Revert only scoped layout/flow changes to the reviewed App state; existing read/save payloads and card assets remain compatible.

canonicalContracts: Existing TarotStage, reading.cards/sourceSnapshot and canonical card meanings are preserved; explanation is displayed seed/context, not provider-private reasoning.
Open Reflection v1 and current A2UI/brand guidelines govern typography and artwork placement.
